text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spectators who watched the race praised 
Hokko Tarumae's performance. As a dirt 
Umamusume, she was splendidly starting to 
capture the spotlight—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That run inspired Copano Rickey and moved 
Smart Falcon's heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to updating her content 
after the race, Hokko Tarumae's popularity 
grew. However, name recognition for 
Tomakomai itself still hasn't risen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she keeps getting results in her 
races, will it really draw attention to 
Tomakomai...? Hokko Tarumae's anxiety 
grows ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she had only just stepped onto 
the front lines of dirt racing. Believing 
that taking the top spot would change 
everything, she set her sights on the 
Kawasaki Kinen.
